rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for the bright red colour meant by “scarlet”.

example.english: The scarlet on this shirt is really eye-catching.
example.traditional: 呢件衫嘅鮮紅色好搶眼。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 saam1 ge3 sin1 hung4 sik1 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this for a vivid, strong red when the exact scarlet shade is not important.

example.english: They chose scarlet as the main colour for the wedding.
example.traditional: 佢揀咗大紅色做婚禮嘅主色。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaan2 zo2 daai6 hung4 sik1 zou6 fan1 lai5 ge3 zyu2 sik1

rows.note: Use this as the precise colour name in descriptions, labels, or more formal contexts.

example.english: The label states that this paint is scarlet.
example.traditional: 標籤上寫明呢款顏料係猩紅色。
example.jyutping: biu1 cim1 soeng6 se2 ming4 nei1 fun2 ngaan4 liu2 hai6 sing1 hung4 sik1
